title: The Effects of Phototherapy in Preterm Infants Pda
brief_summary: The study was designed to assess whether chest shielding during phototherapy reduces the incidence of PDA, as assessed by serial echocardiographic examinations, in a population of extremely preterm infants born at lower 30 week gestation.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Gestational week ≤ 30 weeks receiving phototherapy due to jaundice and infants who can perform echocardiography before and after treatment will be included in the study.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Babies with congenital heart disease.
* Infants with major structural anomalies and infants who can not undergo echocardiography before or after treatment.
condition: Patent Ductus Arteriosus After Premature Birth
